summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with separability matrix computation for nested CompoundModels but may lack comprehensive testing and could benefit from additional clarity in documentation.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new case for the '&' operator in the separability matrix calculation but does not include additional tests to cover various scenarios involving nested CompoundModels.
The PR modifies the behavior of the separability matrix calculation without updating the relevant docstrings or comments to reflect the changes.
